models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Injection Pump (J399) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Injection Pump (J399)

Kontrol edin:  Communication to Injection Pump (J399)
See Measuring Value Block (MVB) 018
technicalNotes: When found on 2.5l V6 TDI, turn the key OFF, disconnect the car's battery for a few minutes, then re-connect it and try clearing faults again. See TPI # 962201
